productOverview.headline: Built for Precision, Ready for the Field
productOverview.description: The FOIF A90 is a multi-frequency, multi-constellation GNSS receiver designed for high-precision RTK surveys. It offers robust performance even in challenging environments, making it ideal for cadastral, construction, and engineering projects.

keyFeatures.headline: Key Features
keyFeatures.description: A closer look at what makes the A90 a dependable field partner.

items.title: Multi-Constellation Support
items.description: Tracks GPS, GLONASS, BeiDou, and Galileo for maximum satellite availability.

items.title: Centimeter-Level Accuracy
items.description: Delivers RTK positioning accuracy of ±1 cm + 1 ppm horizontally.

items.title: Advanced Connectivity
items.description: Equipped with Bluetooth, UHF, and 4G for seamless data transmission.

items.title: Long Battery Life
items.description: All-day operation with hot-swappable battery support.

engineAndSignal.headline: GNSS Engine & Signal Reception
engineAndSignal.description: Multi-constellation, all-band tracking for maximum satellite visibility.
list: All constellation and all band reception

performance.headline: Performance
performance.description: Field-proven accuracy and speed you can rely on.

configurationAndConnectivity.headline: Configuration & Connectivity
configurationAndConnectivity.description: Flexible setup options and dependable data links in the field.
list: Tilt survey: IMU inertial navigation, 6-axis, 400Hz dynamic output, calibration-free
WiFi: 802.11b/g/n, WebUI management for firmware, data, settings
Radio: Internal 1W (5km), External 2/35W (15km), supports multiple protocols (TrimTalk450S, PCC-EOT, HiTarget, GeoTalk, etc.)

physicalAndBattery.headline: Physical & Battery
physicalAndBattery.description: A rugged build and all-day power for demanding sites.
list: Material: magnesium alloy base, polymer top
Battery: 7.4V x 3400mAh x2, removable, smart lithium with power indicator
User interface: 4 LED lights, TF & SIM slots, TNC port, 5-pin & 7-pin lemo ports, voice broadcast

environmentalSpecs.headline: Environmental Specs
environmentalSpecs.description: Engineered to keep performing through heat, dust, rain, and drops.
list: Shock: 2 m pole drop resistant at normal temperature

specs.description: Complete technical details for the FOIF A90 RTK GNSS system.

includedInPackage.headline: Included in Package
includedInPackage.description: Everything you need to get surveying, right out of the box.

items.label: Base Unit
items.description: The A90 receiver configured as the base station for broadcasting corrections.

items.label: Rover Unit
items.description: The A90 receiver configured as the rover for on-site data collection.

items.label: Controller Unit(RC)
items.description: Handheld controller for managing surveys, settings, and data in the field.

items.label: Tripod
items.description: Sturdy tripod for stable base station setup.

items.label: Internal & External Radios
items.description: Built-in and external radio options for reliable correction transmission.

items.label: Rover Rod
items.description: Carbon-fiber rod for precise handheld RTK measurements.

items.label: Software Suite
items.description: Processing and management software to handle your survey data.
